rows.what_the_ink_shows: The boxed Corollary 4 right-hand sign between rho_i(u) and rho_i(v) is a horizontal dark stroke with a small upward projection near its right side, but no clearly resolved downward crossing. It looks minus-like, while the upward projection prevents a secure exclusion of a very compressed plus. The separate special-case inequality immediately below has an unambiguous plus with crossing strokes. These are visible in crops/1_scan040_L1188_corollary.jpg, crops/1_scan040_L1188_sign.jpg, and crops/1_scan040_L1188_special_case.jpg; all were inspected after enlargement and contrast adjustment.
rows.note: The supplied original LaTeX already has an unqualified plus, whereas this row describes an earlier minus/doubt and says the plus was resolved by sense without rereading ink. The present visual check does not justify a certain plus, nor a completely certain minus: preserve the uncertainty as \unsure{-|+} at this one sign. The nearby special-case plus is an observation of written ink, not proof that the boxed sign is plus. This is a transcription-certainty correction while preserving a possible author slip, not a substitution of intended mathematics.
